opportunities.name: Dinner plan: restaurant search + recipe search + note
opportunities.description: For a cuisine/area, search OpenTable for a restaurant, search Allrecipes for a matching recipe, then save a 'Dinner: out at X or cook Y' note.
steps: On OpenTable, type cuisine+area in search box and submit
Open top restaurant result, read rating, price, area
On Allrecipes, search the dish name and open top recipe, read cook time
In Notes, add note 'Dinner: out at <restaurant> (<rating>, <price>, <area>) or cook <recipe> (<time>)'

steps: On Booking, enter destination, pick suggestion
Click Search and open top result

opportunities.name: Call email draft with local time and weather
opportunities.description: For a city, find local time on timeanddate, 10-day forecast on Weather.com, then draft an email to family with time difference and forecast, then discard.
steps: Search city on timeanddate and open result for local time/offset
On Weather.com, change location to city and open 10 Day
Write body with local time, offset, forecast
